terms.body: The moving part of the reformer that glides back and forth, with numbered lines to guide your body positioning and straps on each side for support.
terms.title: The Carriage

terms.body: The two padded bars at the front. Hold them for stability as you step on and off, and during standing and kneeling work.
terms.title: Handle Bars

terms.body: The padded platform that stays still at the front of the machine. You will stand, kneel, and lunge from here while the carriage moves beneath you.
terms.title: Front Platform

alt: Cave reformer from the front, labeled: the carriage, the handle bars, and the front platform.
title: Where you start.

terms.body: The tall pole beside your reformer. Rest a hand on it for balance during standing and single-leg exercises.
terms.title: Balance Pole

terms.body: The cord clipped to the handle bar. It adds extra resistance for arm and leg work when your instructor calls for it.
terms.title: Bungee Strap

terms.body: Mounted at the front of the machine so your water stays within reach for the whole class.
terms.title: Water Bottle Holder

alt: Cave reformer with the balance pole beside it, labeled: balance pole, bungee strap, and water bottle holder.
title: What keeps you steady.

terms.body: The padded black straps along the sides of the carriage. Slip your hands or feet in to stay secure while you press and pull.
terms.title: The Cave Straps
Long Straps
terms.body: The long, padded black straps attached along the outer sides of the reformer carriage. These serve the same function as The Cave Straps but can be used as a modification.
Where your props live: dumbbells, bala ball, and a bala ring ready to grab when the workout calls for them.
terms.title: The Pit

alt: The Cave Straps, Long Straps, and The Pit on our customized Cave reformer.
title: Your tools for the work.

terms.body: The padded platform that stays still at the back of the machine, used for standing, kneeling, and seated work.
terms.title: Back Platform

terms.body: The grey Cave straps that hang from the back posts. They connect to the resistance cables for pulling work with your arms or legs.
terms.title: The Grey Straps

alt: Back corner of the reformer, labeled: the back platform and the grey Cave straps hanging from the back post.
title: Where you finish.
